body.x: Catalyst participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced an Advanced protection case for Airpod.

This Catalyst case for AirPod is a sophisticated and necessary protection case in daily life. This case made of soft premium silicone, is waterproof to 3.3ft(1m). The slim, minimal design let the users to conveniently access the pay port. Using the carabiner included, which can attach the case to a belt, bag or backpack makes it easy to find Airpod.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
